## Bug Report (auto-generated from user feedback)

### Description
The Usage tab is showing duplicate counts and entries. When a user clicks on and off the tab, the counts double each time, leading to massively inflated numbers (e.g. 900,000 additional responses). 

This appears to be caused by a bug in the cache deduplication logic in `usage-section.tsx`, potentially where `provider || "unknown"` mismatches with undefined providers in legacy cache entries, or where `Date.now()` is used as a fallback timestamp for pipes without `started_at`, causing new IDs to be generated on every `loadData` call and continually appending to the cache.

### Environment
- OS: windows 10.0.26200
- App version: 2.3.6
- Affected users: 1+ user reporting

### Evidence
**User feedback:**
> My usage tab is doubling the counts every time I click on and off of it. It says that I did 900,000 additional responses between clicking on and off a moment ago. It was just doubling every time.

### Frequency
- Feedback reports: 1
